name: righelt
description: Righelt web app starter scaffold (Cloudflare free-tier).

scripts.dev:web: cd apps/web && pnpm exec wrangler pages dev . --port 8788
scripts.d1:migrate:dev: pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply ${CLOUDFLARE_D1_DB_NAME:-righelt-db-dev} --config apps/web/wrangler.toml
scripts.deploy:web: cd apps/web && pnpm exec wrangler pages deploy . --project-name ${CLOUDFLARE_PAGES_PROJECT:-righelt}
